body.heading: Where in the world is Burkina Faso?
paragraphs: Burkina Faso is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Burkina Faso is Ouagadougou.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Burkina Faso speak French and Fula.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Burkina Faso is the West African CFA franc. The CFA franc is shared with neighbouring countries, so the same money works across the region.

body.heading: How big is Burkina Faso?
paragraphs: Burkina Faso covers about 273,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Kenya.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: In Tiébélé, women paint the mud-brick houses with bold patterns in black, white and red. Walking its lanes feels like strolling through an outdoor art gallery.
The Sindou Peaks are a ridge of skinny rock towers carved by wind and rain. Families can hike between the stone spires on guided paths near Banfora.
